set.body:
Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-18-best-recall-to-video-mapper.md §3 Phase 1b Scoring and statistics.

The recall segmenter has never been evaluated. Friends WhichEvent runs give recall-unit gold; Sherlock's gold is scene onsets only.

Scope:
Development participants only.

Acceptance criteria:
1. Segmenter boundaries are compared with Friends' WhichEvent runs on development participants only, with metrics declared before running (boundary F1 at stated tolerances, unit-count ratio); the guard's read counter shows no test read.
2. A gold-unit oracle row (mapping gold units instead of segmenter units) is available in the scorer for every corpus with gold units.
3. Word- or time-weighted secondary scoring exists, with a test showing that splitting one unit into two leaves the word-weighted score unchanged.
4. A dated study-log ledger entry (docs/plans/2026-09-02-recall-to-video-study-log.md) naming this read, its estimand and its participants is committed before the first gold read; the readout verifies the commit order.

Gate: every script in tools/recall-study/tests exits 0 (`for t in tools/recall-study/tests/test_*.py;
do python3 "$t" || exit 1; done`), new tests included; a named mutation witness per new guard; no
recall prose or participant text committed (hashes and aggregates only); fresh-context cold review;
the commit body states the evidence and what it does not establish.

Size: M.
set.title: Phase 1b: evaluate RecallSegmenter against Friends development gold; add a gold-unit oracle row
